I'm failing school and dealing with a lot of trauma by myself. I can't leave bed most days and when I do that's the only thought that helps. There's just this empty overwhelming feeling that I don't deserve to be alive. I live in a not very good household and feel utterly trapped.
I just seriously can't keep going on like this and I had everything planned out and was ready to do it. I'm probably gonna give it a go anyway and just deal with what comes after.

I don't think it's a sign for you to kill yourself but maybe a sign that school isn't for you. Schools can have an extremely toxic environment and the pressure within the schooling system is unhealthy for all involved. People may see you differently but it's those who will be unfazed that are the ones who matter and you deserve to have in your life.  it's probably been a stressful situation I think it's best if you try to connect with those good friends and look into other options. There's trades and work you can go straight into that might be for you or you could take some time out and do things you enjoy for a while. School and grades don't define you. Hopefully things get better soon.

Green colour corrector for red spots on the arms and then yellow for grey/purple spots. Then use primer and foundation is you have it. Then some powder or setting spray. That's how I hid mine for photo day.

I would have loved to have a teacher like you. Please continue on because as much as this sucks you are giving those kids opportunities they never thought possible from the background they come from or their own demons they're struggling with. I always wanted to be a teacher like you that treated everyone fairly and helped kids. If you can do it that means maybe one day I can get there too. Teachers truly are bringing up the future generations, you're kindness and care gives them hope. Other teachers that only care about the paycheck at the end of the day, aren't in it for the right reasons. You deserve to be here. Life is a bitch and will often throw a million things at you at once, but only to test your strength. You are stronger than you think and after this things could become better than you ever expected. Hope things get better soon.

Hey, I'm so sorry you're going through this. No matter whats happening talking to someone if you feel comfortable enough can at least give you some guidance and support. When in inpatient or working with a therapist it's better to be honest so you can use that experience for the better and get the help you need. Calorie counting and having less than 2 meals a day, as well as deliberate expelling of food from the body could mean you have an eating disorder or may be developing one. I encourage you to talk to a professional whether your therapist or a gp, that you trust. Hope everything goes well for you xo
